player_prompt.intro:
Droeueuh Player {player_id} lam permainan Indian Poker.
- Dek 52 kartu; droeueuh neu'eujeuen kartu lawan.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) tiep putaran, {max_rounds} putaran total.
- Gerakan valid: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X nakeuh angka positif <= jumeulah chip droeueuh.)
- Kartu tersembunyi paleng tinggi meunang pot lam showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Peubri keuh saboh gerakan lam kurung, misal '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', atawa '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Hana jeut [check] - droeneuh ka teuseurab bak saboh taruhan.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Hana peue lon peugah, jeut neu [check].
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Peuguna '[bet X]' keu buka; hana taruhan yang jeuet naik.
invalid_move.insufficient: Hana chip nyang seb keu aksi nyan.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown seri: keuduwa {card}. Pot dibagi – keuduwa meu'eujeuen {split}.
